prompt_text: Classify this support ticket into Billing, Technical, or Account: 'My invoice shows double tax on order 4412.'
Extract the product SKU and quantity from this message: 'Please ship 15 units of SKU-9082 to the Lagos warehouse.'
Verify whether an HTTP 429 response should trigger an exponential backoff retry or an immediate client abort.

Summarize the following incident log in two bullet points: [08:01] Worker-3 heartbeat delayed 400ms. [08:02] Connection pool utilization reached 82% on db-replica-2. [08:03] Read latency p95 climbed from 14ms to 110ms due to an unindexed analytical query running on the reporting user. [08:04] DBA terminated PID 88412. [08:05] Connection pool dropped back to 38% and p95 latency stabilized at 16ms across all API gateways.

Give a one-sentence status verdict for this deployment audit: Release v2.14.3 passed all 184 unit tests, integration suite passed in 4m12s, canary traffic at 5% showed zero 5xx errors over 30 minutes, memory footprint stayed flat at 1.4GB per pod, and p99 checkout latency improved by 8ms compared to v2.14.2.

Identify the single compliance failure in this contract clause: 'Vendor shall retain all customer payment card numbers in plaintext logs for 180 days to assist with dispute resolution, encrypt backups at rest using AES-256, restrict production SSH access to hardware security keys, and notify Client within 24 hours of any confirmed breach.'
Draft a detailed onboarding checklist for a junior backend engineer joining a Python microservice team, covering local setup, testing, observability, and code review.
Write a step-by-step troubleshooting guide for diagnosing sudden disk space exhaustion on a Linux application server.
Write a thorough architecture decision record comparing token-bucket rate limiting versus sliding-window log rate limiting for a multi-tenant payment API.

Analyze these three overlapping service outage reports and produce a full timeline, root-cause breakdown, and remediation plan: Report A notes Kafka consumer lag spiked on topic orders-events at 14:10 UTC after schema registry timeout. Report B notes inventory-service pods restarted three times between 14:12 and 14:19 UTC due to OOMKilled events when deserializing batched payloads. Report C notes checkout API returned 503 errors from 14:14 to 14:22 UTC until traffic was drained from region-east.

Perform a rigorous security and reliability review of this proposed LLM inference gateway design: All user prompts are forwarded unvalidated to a single FP16 7B model with max_tokens=4096, no input length truncation, shared unbounded request queue, no per-tenant rate limits, and logging of full raw prompts and outputs to shared disk.

Compare two GPU serving configurations for a regulated clinical triage assistant: Config A runs a 4-bit quantized model with max_new_tokens=2048 and batch_size=16; Config B runs FP16 precision with empirical ISL<=768, OSL<=600, batch_size=4, and drift-based throttling. Provide a structured risk and latency justification.
